div.style: height: calc(100vh - 55px); overflow: hidden; position: relative;

div.class: bg-dark text-white p-2 px-3 d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center shadow-sm flex-wrap gap-2 flex-shrink-0
d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3 pb-2 border-bottom
card p-3 shadow-sm rounded-3 border-start border-4 bg-white cursor-pointer wo-map-card
div.t-attf-style: border-left-color: #{'#ef4444' if wo.state == 'late' or wo.permit_alert_status == 'expired' else ('#10b981' if wo.stage_5_status == 'paid' else '#3b82f6')} !important; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;

span.t-attf-class: badge #{'bg-danger' if wo.state == 'late' or wo.permit_alert_status == 'expired' else ('bg-success' if wo.stage_5_status == 'paid' else 'bg-primary')}

div.class: d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center border-top pt-2 mt-1

div.style: position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
